stock.description: Autostreets Development Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on providing comprehensive pre-owned vehicle transaction services throughout China. The firm manages a seamlessly integrated online and offline marketplace that effectively connects a wide array of sellers with buyers of used automobiles, concurrently overseeing large-scale auctions for these vehicles. Beyond its core transactional platform, Autostreets furnishes a suite of supplementary services, including value-added support for used cars, services for event management related to exhibitions, and various other automotive provisions such as assisting with title transfers and installing GPS units. Additionally, the company facilitates the direct sale of second-hand vehicles and supplies IT system and internet-based information solutions. Established in 2014, Autostreets Development Limited is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
